embeds.title: BLHA GM LOUNGE
embeds.description: The clubhouse. This is where general managers talk hockey, chirp each other and enjoy the league.

fields.name: USE THESE ROOMS FOR
fields.value: GM Lounge • Game-day talk • Chirps and memes • Off-topic conversation • Media and highlights

fields.name: KEEP IT GOOD
fields.value: Chirp the team, not the person. Keep it fun, keep it respectful, and remember everyone here is a co-owner of the league.

fields.name: NOT FOR OFFICIAL BUSINESS
fields.value: Votes, rulings, trades and deadlines belong in their own rooms. Nothing said in the lounge changes a rule or a result.
